name: Camino Santiaguista de Uclés
description_md:
Camino Santiaguista de Uclés is a waymarked hiking route in Spain spanning a distance of 137.1 km. It involves 978 m of ascent and 1186 m of descent.

The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, with an estimated walking time of about 37 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This trail is part of the national waymarked hiking network. Walkers will find that the route passes Real Cocina de Palacio within 200 m, Real Canal de Manzanares within 200 m, and Madrid within 700 m.
